plugins.description: A pixel buddy above your prompt (panda, dino, cat, penguin, frog, ghost, crab, duck, snail, or a whole scene: a forest, the northern lights, a mountain range, or Kathmandu, Tokyo, Paris or New York) that jumps at your messages, runs while Claude works and naps when you're away
